report_write.receipt: user request dated 2026-09-07 to create an engineering plan

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: Native transport, public backend contract, task/config composition and algorithm/IPC/checkpoint state have distinct owners across four packages.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The plan binds runtime BatchEnvPool.step, unisim BackendSensorHistoryView, ManagerBasedRlEnv public groups and APPORuntime.runner_kwargs without private cross-owner calls.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: mujoco-uni-runtime -> unisim -> UniLab EnvFactory -> uni_rl injection is preserved and reverse uni_rl imports are forbidden.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Init, reset, native callback HISTORY carry, step, terminal/autoreset, async publish/update, save, reload/play and error cleanup are all mapped with invariants.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: P3-C00 through P3-C14 are covered exactly once by dependency-ordered B0 through B4, followed by separately authorized runtime proof.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Plan readiness is separated from implementation, runtime, training and policy-quality claims.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: 195D state, 390D pair, N/T/features, float32 IPC, terminal identity, finiteness, expert hashes/FPS/body order and device transfer are frozen.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: The plan tests frozen D_k reward, detached APPO/V-trace update and subsequent learner-only D_(k+1) mutation.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Full resume uses a complete method fingerprint; actor-only playback uses a narrower explicit matrix; legacy checkpoints fail closed and saves are atomic.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: Each function-level change has a behavior test and stop condition, each batch has entry/exit evidence, and owner/package/offline/runtime/policy-quality gates remain distinct.

residual_risks: The runtime publisher checkout, issue/ADR approvals, construction branches, release hashes and actual tests remain later entry/evidence gates.
A bounded sentinel can prove runtime wiring only; long training and human-like gait quality require separate authorization and audit.
